prompt: Leave the voicemail your dad leaves after you already texted him that your flight landed.
response:
"Hey, it's Dad. 

I know you just texted that you landed, but I figured I'd call anyway just to make sure you actually got off the plane and everything went okay. Your mother was tracking the flight online—looks like you guys had a good tailwind, got in about six minutes early, which is great. 

Are you at baggage claim yet? Just a heads-up, sometimes they change the carousel number on the board last minute, so keep an eye on that. And let me know if you're taking a cab or an Uber. If it's an Uber, make sure you match the license plate before you get in. 

Anyway, I know you text—you sent the text—but just give us a quick ring when you get to the hotel or your friend's place so we know you're fully settled. You don't have to call back right now, just whenever you have your bags. 

Alright. Have a good trip. Love you. 

*[muffled speaking away from the phone]* No, Susan, she didn't answer, I just left a voicemail... yeah, she sent the text... I don't know how to hang this up—" 

*[Beep]*
